LESSON: WRITING 2.3.1 WRITING POSTURE

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Writing 2.3.1 Writing posture
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 2.3.1 Writing posture, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we sit appropriately when writing? 2. Why sit appropriately when writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 2.3.1 Writing posture together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Responsibility: Diligence as the learner is able to sit appropriately when writing and avoid mistakes associated with

inappropriate sitting posture.

● Peace: Love as the learner works in harmony with a partner to practice appropriate sitting posture.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skill on self-awareness as the learner realizes that can sit appropriately and write properly.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Learner relates appropriate writing posture in all the learning areas.

Suggested Suggested Learning Resources:

Assistive devices fitted with appropriate technology such as hearing aids and amplifiers, books, crayons, drawing books, relevant

digital devices, signed audio visual clips.
